title: Dynamics of Indigenous Language Empowerment
description: Explores language revitalization as a source of healing and empowerment. Introduces the human dynamics and political and social factors associated with Indigenous language shift, including the profound psychological, intellectual and spiritual effects on individuals, families, communities and cultures. Sets the foundation for exploring what might be needed in different community contexts to increase the domains of language use in order to create positive change.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of LING 180A, LING 180.
